sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Lilyturf is a clump-forming perennial native to East Asia, where it grows in shady, moist forests, ravines and slopes. It reaches about 30–46 cm in height and width.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its evergreen, arching, linear leaves grow up to 30–46 cm long and about 2.5 cm wide. The lilac flower spikes are 15–20 cm long. The globose berries are green before turning black and are about 8 mm across.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: NC State Extension reports low-severity human toxicity from the fruits; the toxic principle is unidentified and no cases are reported there. Do not eat them.
